trial_type.Description: stim_<channel> = single stimulation pulse delivered at that electrode (release stimset.mat)

stim_amplitude_mA.Description: stimulation amplitude of the pulse train (release field amplitude; unit assumed mA as in the article)

stim_electrode_index.Description: 1-based index of the stimulating electrode in the release struct (same indexing as condensed_ecog)

sample.Description: release field times (sample index at 1000 Hz)
